notes:
I found no toddler underwater basket weaving lessons in Halton Hills. I searched for the activity itself and for the town's fall 2026 toddler programs. The only basket-weaving results were craft kits, a studio's online workshops and a joke about an "easy college class". The town's fall recreation pages list nothing like it for toddlers.

```json
{
  "picks": []
}
```

If the parent's real interest is toddlers and water or crafts, these came up in the search. I haven't made them picks, because they aren't what was asked for.

- **Parent & Tot swim:** 
The Town of Halton Hills' Acton fall schedule lists Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 at $86.22 for 9 lessons, with 30-minute lessons.
 I didn't see a day or time for Parent & Tot.
- **Tiny Dancers, ages 2-3:** 
The Town's fall 2026 schedule has Saturdays 8:30-9:00 AM at Gellert Community Centre, Sep 26 to Dec 12, $117.00 for 12 classes.

- **Parent and Tot gymnastics, 18 months to 3.11 years:** Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's page says 
the fall 2026 session runs September 12 to December 18, with registration opening July 20th.
 I didn't find a class day or time for it.
